mapper.select: SELECT * FROM oa_schedule_event WHERE deleted = '0' AND creator_id = #{userId} AND room_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY start_time DESC

SELECT r.room_id AS roomId, r.name AS roomName, COUNT(e.event_id) AS bookingCount, COALESCE(SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, e.start_time, e.end_time)), 0) AS totalMinutes, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(e.start_time)) AS usedDays FROM oa_meeting_room r LEFT JOIN oa_schedule_event e ON r.room_id = e.room_id AND e.deleted = '0' AND e.start_time >= #{startDate} AND e.end_time <= #{endDate} WHERE r.deleted = '0' GROUP BY r.room_id, r.name ORDER BY bookingCount DESC
